_: CÂBLAGE DU SIMULATEUR — CHEVALIERS DU CHAOS
Écrit à la main : aucune source ne dit ce qu'une règle fait au CALCUL.
extraction.py fusionne ce fichier dans data-chevalierschaos.js, réécrit
à chaque extraction ; celui-ci ne l'est jamais.
LA RÈGLE D'ARMÉE. Des six capacités d'Effroi, une seule touche
l'attaque : « Doom », +1 pour blesser contre une cible Ébranlée. Elle se
déclare — l'application ne sait ni si elle a été retenue, ni si la
cible est Ébranlée. Les autres jouent sur le Commandement adverse.
LES AURAS DES CHEVALIERS sur les CHIENS DE GUERRE se déclarent, comme
toute aura : la distance n'est pas connue de l'application. Les [ASSAUT]
accordés par le Lancer et la Magaera ne changent pas la séquence
d'attaque et ne sont pas câblés.
CE QUI RESTE DEHORS : la « Seething Hatred » du Despoiler (une relance
unique), le +2 contre FORTIFICATION de l'Asterius (le moteur ne connaît
pas ce mot-clé de cible), et les stratagèmes de défense.

War Dog Executioner.texte: This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

War Dog Executioner.quand: La cible est sous la moitié de son effectif
War Dog Executioner.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a unit Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each time an enemy unit is destroyed as the result of this model's attacks, before removing the last model in that unit from the battlefield, each other unit from your opponent's army that is within 3" of it must take a Battle-shock test.

War Dog Stalker.quand: Aucune autre unité adverse à 6" de la cible
War Dog Stalker.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if there are no other units from your opponent’s army within 6" of that target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

War Dog Brigand.quand: La cible est à portée d'un pion d'objectif
War Dog Brigand.texte: Ranged weapons equipped by this model have the [Ignores Cover] ability while targeting enemy units in range of one or more objective markers.

Knight Rampager.quand: Le Chevalier a chargé ce tour
Knight Rampager.texte: Each time this model makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, its melee weapons have the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

Chaos Acastus Knight Porphyrion.quand: Le Chevalier est resté immobile ce tour
Chaos Acastus Knight Porphyrion.texte: Each time this model Remains Stationary, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by this model have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Chaos Cerastus Knight Atrapos.quand: La cible est TITANESQUE ou IMPOSANTE
Chaos Cerastus Knight Atrapos.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is Titanic or Towering, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Knight Ruinator.quand: La cible est sa victime désignée
Knight Ruinator.texte: At the start of the first battle round, select one unit from your opponent's army to be this model's victim. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its victim, you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model's victim is destroyed, select one new enemy unit to be this model's victim.

War Dog Huntsman.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Chaos Acastus Knight Asterius.texte: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Vehicle, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 1 (if that attack targets a Fortification, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 2 instead).

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: La capacité « Doom » est active pour ton armée, et la cible est Ébranlée
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: 2 - Doom: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: Le Chien de Guerre est à 9" du Desecrator
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, each time that War Dog model makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: Le Chien de Guerre est à 9" du Rampager
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, each time that War Dog model makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: Le Chien de Guerre est à 6" de l'Atrapos, et la cible est TITANESQUE ou IMPOSANTE
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, each time that War Dog model makes an attack that targets a Titanic or Towering unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: Le Chien de Guerre est à 6" du Styrix
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: While a friendly War Dog model is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by that War Dog model have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: Le Chien de Guerre est à 9" du Ruinator, et la cible est l'unité ennemie la plus proche
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: While a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of this model, each time that War Dog model makes an attack that targets the closest enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Friendly KNIGHT TYRANT units’ attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have +1 to the hit roll.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: La cible est la proie désignée à ta phase de Commandement, et visible
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a War Dog model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that unit is visible to the attacking model, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: L'unité est Renforcée et choisit les Touches Létales
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: Diabolic Power: When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability.

AURAS_ARMEE.quand: L'unité est Renforcée et choisit les Touches Soutenues 1
AURAS_ARMEE.texte: Diabolic Power: When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability.

STRAT_SIMU.aide: touche critique sur 5+ — deux CHIENS DE GUERRE au contact de la même cible
relance des 1 pour toucher et pour blesser — contre le MONSTRE ou VÉHICULE désigné
relance des touches et des blessures ratées — la cible désignée est TITANESQUE
+1 en PA en mêlée — le Chevalier a chargé ce tour
